title: First Game Store Page Live
author: Tookitooki12
selftext:
It's wild that someone like me (different industry, avid gamer, father, husband all meaning free time is between 8:30PM and whenever I go to bed) can use AI to make what I have in my head come to life and actually published on Steam. It may not be "good" or "fun" but I hope it is fun to some folks. I did not one-shot this and this took me a few months (mostly around system design and in-game AI tweaking and validation tests).

Premise is a chess game where the AI feels less like AI (selective blindness, depth visibility, limited thinking time) and where players can learn to get better at chess through chess puzzles and matches against varying AI difficulties. There is also a ledger where chess concepts are organized as player encounters them, and a hero/chess army customization system. 

Art is a mix of asset packs, and Gen-AI (sketches, first draft, too many iterations on nitpicking details ).  

Demo build is approved and so is the main store page, but the demo store page is still pending approval so demo will be released hopefully this week! 

Plan right now is release the demo, gather feedback, and continue to tweak / update the main build until release sometime in the next year. Any feedback would be greatly appreciated! 

Any feedback, tips on marketing/PR/release would also be much much appreciated from the veterans! (example: should I have waited on this post until I was able to release the demo??) 

TIA!

[https://store.steampowered.com/app/5271310/Kingside\_Break/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5271310/Kingside_Break/)
